en: A black‑and‑white street view of a historic European town with cobblestone pavement and multi‑story townhouses lining the right side. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street, and a small vendor cart stands in the foreground. Shop signs in German are visible on the facades, including an inn or guesthouse. The street curves gently into a small square bordered by more traditional gabled buildings.
